description:
You are working in Juris-M (Jurism), a legal reference manager. The library contains several US Supreme Court cases and law review articles organized in collections.

A collection named 'Research' exists in the left-side collections pane. It contains several legal references.

Your task: Rename the collection 'Research' to 'First Amendment Jurisprudence'.

To do this, right-click on the 'Research' collection in the left pane, select 'Rename Collection...' from the context menu, clear the old name, type the new name 'First Amendment Jurisprudence', and press Enter to confirm.

IMPORTANT: Rename the existing collection — do NOT delete it and create a new one. All items currently in the collection must be preserved.
